# AP 启动日志分类

## 有必要（保留，关键状态/错误/告警）

| 行 | 内容 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| `ap_bridg:I(3)` | MB_UART0 初始化 | 日志通道本身，基础信息 |
| `ef:I(5)` / `ef:I(7)` | EasyFlash 环境地址/初始化成功 | 存储子系统状态 |
| `I(10):driver_init` | PSRAM 初始化 ok | 内存关键状态 |
| `sensor:W(10)` | sdcadc 未校准值 | 告警，需关注 |
| `cal:E(14)` / `cal:E(107)` / `cal:E(111)` | polar tab magic code error | 校准数据缺失错误，**必须保留** |
| `cal:W(16)` | temp in otp | 告警 |
| `cal:I(107)` | idx/r/xtal/pwr_gain | 校准结果 |
| `wifi:I(108)` | wifi inited ret(0) | 关键状态 |
| `ap0: IPC: HW_CTRL power-up` | 电源握手 | 双核启动关键 |
| `ap0: PWC: CPU1 boot-ready` | CPU1 就绪 | 关键 |
| `bluetoot:W(440)` | bt already initialised | 告警 |
| `ap0: PSRAM online` | PSRAM 上线 | 关键 |
| `ap0: ramdisk` | ram0 注册 | 存储 |
| `ap0: board bring-up completed` | 板级完成 | 里程碑 |
| `ap0: gc9d01: hardware reset/init/sent` | 屏初始化 | 显示关键 |
| `ap0: gc9d01_fb: /dev/fb0 registered` | 帧缓冲注册 | 关键 |
| `ap0: bk7258_camera_bringup` | camera 注册返回 0 | 关键 |
| `ap0: bk7258_audio` | audio 设备注册 | 关键 |
| `ap0: bk7258_jpeg` | video1 注册 | 关键 |
| `ap0: NuttShell (NSH)` | 系统进入 shell | 里程碑 |
| `ap0: IPC: heartbeat queued/ACK` | 心跳状态 | 运行健康监测 |

## 无需（冗余/可降级为 debug 或删除）

| 行 | 内容 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| `rwnx_cal_set_rfconfig` | phy on; rf off | debug 细节 |
| `flash txpwr table:0xf` | 功率表 dump | debug |
| `xtal_cali:33` | 晶振校准中间值 | debug |
| `wakeup` | 裸输出 | 无上下文 |
| `ap0: mailbox UART0 link ready` | 与 ap_bridg 重复 | 冗余 |
| `ap0: mailbox transport...handshake complete` | 与前面握手重复 | 冗余 |
| `ap0: heartbeat worker started` | 与后续 heartbeat 重复 | 冗余 |
| `ap0: button GPIOs configured, count=3` | 可选，仅配置确认 | 可降级 |
| `ap0: PWM device registered` | 可选 | 可降级 |
| `ap0: power-key motor` (3条) | 电机/马达调试细节 | debug |
| `ap0: gc9d01: qspi0 init` | 内部步骤 | debug |
| `ap0: bk7258_qspi1: init/first cmd` | QSPI 寄存器细节 | debug |
| `ap0: gc9d01: sleep-out settle delay` | 内部时序 | debug |
| `ap0: gc9d01_fb: test pattern drawn` | 测试图 | debug |
| `ap0: bk7258_qspi1: frame 0` | 帧传输寄存器 | debug |
| `ap0: gc9d01_fb: update 1: ...` | 单帧耗时 | debug |
| `ap0: bk7258_audio: ... PA mute/HT6872` | 硬件细节 | debug |
| `ap0: bt-ipc: tx-cmd opcode=...` (14条) | 蓝牙 IPC 逐条命令 | **最冗余，应删除或仅汇总** |

## 建议

1. **bt-ipc 14 条**命令逐个打印，建议改成仅在失败或开关时打印汇总。
2. **QSPI/帧传输寄存器级 dump**（`config=0x...`）仅调试期需要，发布版应去掉。
3. **错误类（cal:E）和告警类（sensor:W/bluetoot:W）必须保留**，这些是量产分析的关键。

agent's net_test with the expected handshake line quoted.  Also spelled out
that net_status's "Network connected: yes" is not evidence -- it only checks
whether an address is configured and says the same thing with the interface
down.

encode=8000 marks the open networks and one of those is enough to verify the
path without any password; and a note that the first `renew` after association

docs: the 8.16 network gate is through -- association to HTTP 200, measured

The gate's last open item is closed, and it needed no credentials: several of
the scanned networks report encode=8000, i.e. open, so the whole chain was
exercised without a password going anywhere near the repo or a log.

  wapi scan wlan0        22 BSSes, with bssid / frequency / signal / encoding
  wapi essid wlan0 ...   ifconfig goes UP -> RUNNING
  renew wlan0            inet addr:10.192.105.127  Mask:255.255.254.0
  ping www.baidu.com     PING 220.181.111.232      (DNS answered)
  net_test               Handshake OK: TLSv1.2 / TLS-DHE-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA
                         SUCCESS! HTTP Status: 200

Three things worth more than the pass itself, all of them things that would
have cost somebody an afternoon:

**The first `renew` after association can fail.**  It printed
netlib_obtain_ipv4addr() failed, and the retry succeeded.  Anything automating
provisioning has to retry rather than believe the first attempt.

**ping is the wrong connectivity test on this network.**  ICMP to the internet
loses 100% while DNS and TLS work in the same session, so the network filters
it.  WiFi使用说明.md told the reader to trust ping; it now says to look for
RUNNING plus a non-default address, or to run net_test.

**The HTTPS is encrypted but not authenticated.**  The handshake log says
UNIX=328 -- seconds since boot, because there is no RTC and no SNTP -- and
upstream forces the clock to 2026 so that certificates do not all look
not-yet-valid.  vela_tls.c also sets MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL, and no CA
bundle is installed.  So the plan's 9.2 promise, "TLS with certificate
verification", is currently half kept.  Closing it needs SNTP, then a root
certificate for the endpoint, then VERIFY_REQUIRED, in that order.  Recorded as
the top debt item rather than left as an assumption.
